description: Combine 2 to 10 PDFs into one document, in the order given. Use this to join separate scans, chapters or invoices into a single file. Password-protected files must be unlocked first. The input is uploaded to the Papyrio API, processed in memory and not stored. The result is written to output_path, replacing any file already there, and the call returns that path and the size in bytes. Inputs are limited to 50 MB, and each call counts as one operation against the daily quota.

files.description: Absolute paths to the PDFs, in the order they should appear.

output_path.description: Absolute path to write the result to. Defaults to the input file with a "-papyrio.pdf" suffix.

name: merge_pdfs
